forecastAssumptions: No damage is committed using floating weapons.
All T2 bombs are assumed to reach their full 150k damage against Mages.
sourceGuidance: Complete the USER INPUT BOARD STATE on Day 3, preferably with more than 20 hours remaining.
Aim for roughly 500k–1M cannon-damage overflow over expected non-Mage HP because sleep can cause cannon damage to enter Mages.
If cannon damage is insufficient for maximum Mages, sacrifice Mage kills one at a time and recalculate.
Keep a Mage on the board if you cannot check often enough to always have targets; the source recommends doing the math before choosing AT2.
